basic_details.job_title: Tribal Development Branch Balod Chhattisgarh Sports Coach Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for Tribal Development Branch Balod Chhattisgarh Sports Coach Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://balod.gov.in/.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 28-09-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Sports Coach post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Sports Coach post is 28 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for the Sports Coach position?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the total number of vacancies for the Sports Coach post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Daily Wage Sports Coach / Trainer in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Sports Coach recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Merit List, followed by a Claim Objection period.
